SPARC Fractions Addition

This is a concrete TutorScript/SPARC package instance aligned to the CTAT 1416 fraction-addition behavior. It keeps SPARC nodes as the document units, adds behaviorRefs for CTAT SAI labels, and represents behavior declaratively with dependency steps, path-scoped responses, hints, feedback, completion, and model targets.

Learners may use either the least common denominator path (12) or the common-denominator path (24) followed by reduction to 5/12.

sparcsession.calculateProbability: p.y = -0.77 + .665 * pFunc.logitdec( p.overallOutcomeHistory.slice( Math.max(p.overallOutcomeHistory.length-60, 0),  p.overallOutcomeHistory.length),  .966)+ .51* (p.stimSuccessCount) + 11.1 * pFunc.recency(p.stimSecsSinceLastShown, .443) ; p.probability = 1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-p.y)); return p
